title: 22.8. Kusalattika, Mahantaraduka

verses.t: Nakusalaṁ nasārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
